北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适。外出记得防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and pleasant. Remember sun protection and hydration when out!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波大雨大风，体感较凉。请务必带伞，注意出行安全。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has heavy rain and strong winds, feeling cool. Be sure to bring an umbrella and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，体感湿热。出门带伞，注意防潮。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain and feels muggy. Take an umbrella and mind the humidity.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感微热。记得多喝水，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and a bit warm. Remember to drink water and stay refreshed.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴热，体感炎热。做好防晒，及时补充水分。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot. Protect yourself from the sun and hydrate frequently.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州中雨大风，体感凉意。出门带好雨具，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has moderate rain and strong winds, feeling chilly. Bring your umbrella and keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感闷热。注意通风，保持舒畅。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and muggy. Ensure good ventilation to stay comfortable.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度百分百！体感闷热，注意防潮。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with 100% humidity! It feels stuffy, so mind the dampness.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度低。出行请注意交通安全哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, with low visibility. Please drive safely when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴天，湿度偏高。体感舒适，记得多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, with high humidity. It feels comfortable, so remember to drink water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感偏热。及时补水，避免中暑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels warm. Hydrate promptly to prevent heatstroke.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，气温宜人。早晚温差大，注意添衣。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and pleasant. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，气温适中。享受阳光，心情棒棒哒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and mild. Enjoy the sunshine and have a great day!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，体感凉爽。记得带伞，注意保暖别着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain and feels cool. Bring an umbrella and keep warm to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感舒适。注意防晒，保持好心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and feels pleasant. Mind sun protection and stay cheerful.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感舒适。外出记得多喝水。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels comfortable. Remember to drink more water when out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感宜人。微风习习，享受好天气。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and pleasant. Enjoy the gentle breeze and nice weather.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云有风，体感舒适。外出注意防晒。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy and windy, feeling pleasant. Remember sun protection when out.
漳浦.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 5级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨大风，体感较凉。出行请备雨具，注意安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has moderate rain and strong winds, feeling cool. Bring an umbrella and stay safe!
